title: bitand
summary: Compute bitwise AND for integer-valued scalars and arrays.

gpu_support.notes: GPU inputs gather to host for integer bit operations.

description: `bitand(A, B)` applies bitwise AND to finite nonnegative integer-valued inputs using MATLAB-style implicit expansion.
behaviors: Accepts double integer-valued inputs, logical inputs, integer scalar values, integer-class tensors, and gatherable gpuArray tensors.
Supports implicit expansion across compatible shapes.
For mixed unsigned integer inputs, returns the widest unsigned integer class involved; double and logical inputs return double-compatible numeric results.
Rejects fractional, negative double, infinite, NaN, complex, string, cell, and struct inputs.

faqs.question: Can `bitand` broadcast scalar masks?
faqs.answer: Yes. Scalar masks expand across array inputs using MATLAB-compatible implicit expansion.

gpu_residency: GPU inputs are gathered for host execution.
gpu_behavior: RunMat currently executes integer bitwise functions on the host.
